scripts.add:android: capacitor add android && npm run assets:android
scripts.add:ios: capacitor add ios && npm run assets:ios
scripts.assets: npm run assets:ios && npm run assets:android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run sync:android && capacitor build android
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -target App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:ios:release: npm run sync:ios && capacitor build ios
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:android-assets && capacitor sync && npm run assets
scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:android-assets && capacitor sync android && npm run assets:android
scripts.sync:ios: capacitor sync ios && npm run assets:ios
